newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUMA'S NELES-JAMESBURY TO EXPAND OUTPUT.
newsitem.headline: RAUMA'S NELES-JAMESBURY TO EXPAND OUTPUT.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said in a statement on Monday its Neles-Jamesbury unit would increase the production capacity for digital valve positioners at its Helsinki factory.

Neles-Jamesbury, among the global leaders in digital valve technology and control solutions for the pulp and paper industry, refining, petrochemical and related chemical industries, would also invest in the development of its global after-sales services, Rauma said.

Construction would start in the summer, and the new building will be completed by August 1998. "The investment will increase the number of jobs in the coming years by 30-50 people," Rauma said, noting Neles-Jamesbury currently employed 800 people in Helsinki.
